name: seoul-retrospective-development-v1
purpose: First real temporal development track: retrospective completed-hour/day rental-demand estimation conditional on observed weather. NOT ahead-of-time forecasting, official benchmark replication, or fresh confirmation.

historical_inventory.policy: Keep the original pending inventory unchanged as review history.

admission_review.scope: Public primary metadata, license notice and one bounded 598942-byte public CSV audit; no models or performance inspection.
admission_review.family_identity: UCI 560 Seoul, not the historically exposed INRIA/Capital Bikeshare origin. This distinction is not a confirmation-freshness claim.
admission_review.target_decision: The official narrative describes hourly rented-bike count. Override the API's erroneous Functioning Day target role explicitly; exclude that operating-status column from all predictors.
admission_review.time_decision: The complete CSV uses day/month/year, despite the metadata narrative saying year-month-day. Exactly 365 calendar days each contain all 24 distinct integer Hour values. Return Date-only timestamps: all 24 hourly rows in a calendar day share one indivisible forward-split bucket. Do not return separate groups or add Hour to timestamps.
admission_review.availability_limit: Date-at-midnight values are ordering markers, not exact feature/label publication times. No intraday availability, timezone, reporting lag or label-end timestamp is inferred. Observed contemporaneous weather is allowed only because the task is explicitly retrospective.
admission_review.runner_requirement: Route Date-only timestamps through every outer and inner forward split with groups=None and label_end_times=None. The shared splitter keeps equal timestamp blocks together. No shuffled CV, same-day train/test overlap or pooling with IID confirmation scores.

datasets.name: uci-seoul-bike
datasets.prediction_time: Retrospective estimation of a completed hour's rented-bike count using that hour's observed weather and calendar context. Whole-day-blocked forward evaluation assesses transfer to later recorded days, NOT what could have been predicted before the weather/day was observed.

time_policy.blocking_key: Date-only timestamps shared by all 24 rows of the calendar day
time_policy.timestamp: Strictly parsed Date only; midnight is a day-bucket marker, not an availability time
time_policy.label_availability: No separate availability column exists; do not infer one from Date, Hour or a horizon.
time_policy.completed_day_assumption: Rows scored for a day represent completed hourly observations; use earlier whole days for training. All 24 hours of a day remain on one side of every split. Calendar ordering establishes neither intraday availability nor operational publication times or delays.

datasets.evaluation_notes: Retain all 8760 rows, including zero counts on non-functioning periods; do not condition row inclusion on the dropped operating-status field. Date supplies day-bucket timestamps only, groups=None, and Hour remains a predictor. This is a separate retrospective temporal-development scoreboard, not forecasting.

rights.approval_basis: The original UCI dataset publication explicitly grants CC BY 4.0; the user approved this bounded retrospective development admission after review of the target and time policy.
rights.obligations: Retain the UCI dataset/original-contributor citation and disclose the target-role override and retrospective framing. No hosted row sharing is approved.

target_role_override.rationale: UCI's task narrative explicitly describes hourly rented-bike demand, but its API marks Functioning Day Target and Rented Bike Count Feature. Treat the count as the reviewed regression target and exclude the entire original metadata-target field. Neither role nor target is guessed at load time.

time_audit.provider_policy: Return Date-only day buckets and groups=None; retain Hour solely as a predictor. Never synthesize intraday or label-availability times.
